about.title: About LumenRead
about.privacy: LumenRead works entirely on your computer. There is no account and no telemetry. Your documents, your voice recordings and your vocabulary never leave this machine. The only network use is the one-time download of models. The optional content curator is off by default.
about.upstream: LumenRead is a fork of LLMersion-1, the open-source reference implementation of the LLMersion scheme: a local-first AI agent framework for low-cost home language learning. It keeps the original listening–reading–speaking–writing loop and adds an Arabic interface, English-to-Arabic translation, OCR for scanned PDFs and a new identity. The original paper is “LLMersion: A Local-First AI Agent Framework for Low-Cost Home Language Learning toward Educational Equity”.
about.license: The code is released under the MIT License, including the original LLMersion copyright notice. The models are not part of the code: each keeps its own license, listed below, and none is bundled with the app.
about.models_note: Weights are downloaded from their publishers on first use. Check each model card before redistributing.
about.fonts: Inter, Cairo, Noto Naskh Arabic, Source Serif 4 and IBM Plex Mono are bundled under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, so the app never contacts a font server.
